title: Price PRs whose sessions ran from a worktree directory in krn ledger
body:
Outcome: `krn ledger` reads transcripts of every Claude project directory whose cwd is this repository or one of its worktrees (.krn/worktrees/*), so no merged PR stays unpriced for lack of a transcript.
Why: t-4f3r88w proof (.krn/runs/ledger-cost/proof.md): 5 of the last 30 PRs (#453, #466, #467, #468, #474) have no cost; sessions started inside a worktree write to another ~/.claude/projects directory.
Proof: ledger on the last 30 PRs prices at least 28, recorded under .krn/runs/.
Scope: this repository.
